Child of C11-336. Contract: docs/markdown-viewer-design.md (binding). Builds against R1's bridge (Resources/markdown-viewer/BRIDGE.md) in parallel; lands after R1.

Scope: the native markdown panel on WKWebView, replacing MarkdownUI.

- `MarkdownPanelView` hosts a WKWebView loading R1's bundle through a custom URL scheme handler (no file:// broad access); local images resolve only beside the open document (scoped read, no traversal outside what rendering needs); CSP blocks remote loads; JS from the document never runs; link clicks arrive over the bridge and route through c11 (http(s) → default browser or c11 browser per existing policy, relative .md → open in a markdown panel for now, anchors → in-page) and the web view's own navigation is cancelled. Record the panel's threat notes in docs/security-threat-model.md.
- Weight: one shared WKProcessPool / configuration, lazy web view creation for panels never shown. Measure memory and creation time with 20 markdown panels in a tagged build (Atlas), compare with a tagged origin/main build, record both and the load average.
- State model on MarkdownPanel: fontScale, theme, typeface, outlineOpen (explicit open/hide or nil = width default); per panel; last used in any panel becomes the new-panel default (extends markdown.fontScale.lastUsed); session snapshot carries theme, typeface and outline beside fontScale (SessionPersistence.swift, Workspace.swift restore); unknown/out-of-range/unreadable values fall back to the default for that field.
- Existing paths keep working: `c11 markdown open`, live reload (file watch → push text, R1 re-renders changed blocks, scroll held), drop-to-open, session snapshot/restore, focus flash, pointer focus, the app-wide zoom keys through WorkspaceManager.zoomInFocusedMarkdown / zoomOutFocusedMarkdown / resetZoomFocusedMarkdown driving the markdown scale; WKWebView page zoom and magnification never intercept ⌘= / ⌘− / ⌘0. Existing markdown tests stay green or get behavioural replacements. markdown.get_content keeps working.
- Remove MarkdownUI (package dependency) and FencedCodeRenderer/MermaidRenderer's Mermaid path once nothing uses them.
- Minimal interim chrome is fine (file name row); the full toolbar is R3.
- No runModal on agent-reachable paths; socket threading and focus policy hold; dlog DEBUG-gated.

Proof: tagged Atlas build, markdown panel opens docs/c11-messaging-primitive-design.md offline with Mermaid; live reload mid-scroll without drift; restore after relaunch with non-default scale/theme/typeface; a malicious fixture (script tags, onerror, javascript: links, remote image) does nothing; the 20-panel numbers.

Validator scenario for the stacked C11-359 head (perform GUI work only in a disposable Atlas sandbox guest; no operator-session activation):

2. Launch the retained tagged app in a fresh Atlas sandbox with a verified guest display and hard termination timer. Keep the starter four-area layout. Copy docs/c11-messaging-primitive-design.md into the guest. Run scripts/validation/markdown-panels-memory.py with the exact guest socket, copied document and output JSON, --metric both --renderer-events /tmp/cmux-debug-com.stage11.c11.debug.md.359.log --reshow-count 10. Attribute only the socket listener and WebKit processes whose responsible PID matches it. Keep raw footprint reports.
3. For the visible restoration witness, use a single 920px-wide area and at least six messaging panels. Verify the exact guest frontmost PID and actual window bounds before input. Scroll panel A to the architecture paragraph and Mermaid diagram; capture its window screenshot. Select five other panels, await A’s native eviction event, then return to A and await its restored/ready events. Expect the same source line and offset within one CSS pixel, nonzero hidden/eviction viewport dimensions, and the same visible paragraph/diagram positions. No workspace/window activation is allowed outside the guest.
4. While A remains scrolled, extend a paragraph above the viewport without changing the source line count. Await the native render event and confirm the changed model text through public markdown.get_content. Capture a second screenshot; expect the same visible paragraph/heading Y position and no jump. File changes while an evicted reader is absent must update the model without allocating WebKit; the host regression covers this path.

Expect the same panel UUID and all four preference values after resume.

Expect inert displayed markup, the blocked-image placeholder, no executable marker or script dialog, and no reader navigation.
